news.headline: Kalshi traders think the bitcoin rally could end the year near current levels
news.summary: Prediction market traders on Kalshi are betting bitcoin ends 2026 roughly where it stands today, signaling skepticism about further gains from current levels. The wager reflects caution among speculators despite the recent rally.

educational.title: Why Company Earnings Move Stock Prices So Much
points: Stock prices reflect expectations — earnings reports test if those expectations were right
Beating profit estimates doesn't guarantee a stock rises if guidance disappoints
'Guidance' — a company's own forecast — often matters more than the past quarter
Markets move on the surprise, not the number itself
This is why a profitable company's stock can still crash on earnings day
